text:
frank (partnerships): SkylineAI submitted a bundle claiming "open weights" and "commercial redistribution". They gave a contributors.csv and a short license note but no verifiable signatures. We need to triage redistribution channels, hardware bundling, and announcement timing.

mina (legal): First pass: ask for cryptographic proof of origin (sigstore/GPG), contributor CLAs or DCO log, and a precise breakdown: code license, model weights license, dataset licenses. If any dataset is CC-BY-SA or has patent encumbrances, downloads may be blocked.

owen (hw-partner): For edge bundling we need an explicit binary redistribution grant to authorized resellers and a security contact. Also want package signing and a short SOW for preloaded devices.

clare (marketplace): Marketplace options: hosted-only, partner-bundle (restricted), or downloadable redistributable. Until proofs are provided, mark SkylineAI as hosted-only + badge "redistribution pending". Also need exact attribution text if CC-BY appears.

ben (product): Product stance: allow hosted API quickly, gate all downloads and partner bundles behind legal + provenance checks. Require quantized builds, benchmarks, and a canary (5% traffic) with telemetry and auto-revert on legal/takedown signals.

provenance-bot: SCAN: no verified signatures detected in submitted artifacts. FLAG: provenance_missing (HIGH). Recommend blocking redistributable SKUs until fixed.

mina (legal): Draft redistribution snippet (rough): "Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host the Model. Redistribution of model binaries to third parties or hardware partners requires Provider's prior written consent and explicit redistribution language. Provider warrants it has the rights to grant such licenses and that the Model does not contain materials subject to incompatible ShareAlike obligations."

frank (partnerships): Also SkylineAI asked for a co-announcement + joint webinar. We should hold any public marketing until legal confirms redistribution and export checks. If they want co-marketing, require 2-week lead time and pre-approved copy.

own (hw-partner): If Provider agrees to hardware carveout, we'll need: signed binary redistribution clause, package signing, vulnerability disclosure contact, and reseller list. Revenue share TBD.

clare (marketplace): Listing metadata we'll require: model_size, quant_variants, runtime_compat, latency/throughput benchmarks, attribution_text, allowed_channels (hosted/dedicated/redistribute), ops_contact. For non-redistributable models show badge "No downloads".

ben (product): Canary snippet example: `deploy.canary(percent=5, telemetry=true, auto_revert_on=["takedown","legal_claim"])` 

frank (partnerships): Action items: (1) Frank to request signed release (sigstore/GPG), CLAs/DCO proof, SBoM, dataset manifests, and export-origin statement from SkylineAI (ETA 72h). (2) Mina to post attestation template and redistribution clause draft (ETA 48h). (3) Owen to draft HW-bundle checklist + sample SOW. (4) Clare to stage listing flags and marketing hold rules. I'll schedule a 20-min sync with SkylineAI + Legal for tomorrow 10:30 PT.

mina (legal): I'll add a short FAQ on CC-BY vs CC-BY-SA impacts and a sample attribution snippet to the partnerships board after the sync.

frank (partnerships): Thanks team. Please update this thread with document links when posted. :handshake:
